reviewer.role: independent evaluator, not candidate author or rescue

stage_pin_status: queue stage pin recorded; opaque stage manifest not read/independently rehashed

eligibility.carrier_completeness: current report/protocol/eligibility/brief/plan/source present; actual views/acquisition intentionally locked

coverage_meaning: Every material current assertion, repeated occurrence, assigned facet, condition/omission/negative constraint, novelty and proposed test assessed. Shared atomic source outcomes may occupy one row. Process assertions explicitly unresolved. Quality failures do not make assessment incomplete.

claims.claim: Opaque case/corpus/schema identity, report date, standalone current pass with no prior answers/source lists reused.
claims.reason: Corpus/schema match catalog and date matches task environment; frozen current report is standalone semantically. No-reuse history is not provable in phase 1 and treatment label is a blinding limit.

claims.reason: Full reviewer read and byte hash match; document metadata 0.5 is distinct from capture-only pin.

claims.reason: Reviewer-computed plan hash/size match.

claims.claim: Four S003 aliases, one ngff.openmicroscopy.org/0.5 URL and three unrecorded origins, shared capture-only pin.
claims.reason: All count/identifier/URL/version tokens match.

claims.claim: Only S003 is admitted and no live fetching permitted; no second source exists in admitted corpus.
claims.reason: Complete source list contains exactly S003. Bounded corpus absence is not worldwide absence.

claims.claim: Full 896-line read and targeted completeness check were performed and nothing else was skipped.
claims.reason: Actual read/search operations are inaccessible during phase 1. Source availability and locators can be validated, not execution.

claims.claim: Every finding has source/version locators bound to S003.
claims.reason: All findings carry locators and capture version; citation presence does not guarantee correct normativity/scope interpretation. Specific failures are graded independently.

claims.claim: OME-Zarr fileset is Zarr v3, each image is a group with multiscales/omero attributes, several images may be side by side.
claims.reason: v3/image-group layout supported. Metadata is in attributes.ome; omero is optional, correctly qualified later.

claims.claim: Layout can be local, HTTP or object storage.
claims.reason: Source permits all locations. The product remains local-only; report does not mandate adding remote support.

claims.claim: Levels are separate arrays with arbitrary names and metadata ordering, often numbered from 0.
claims.reason: Folder numbering is illustrative rather than authority.

claims.claim: Image arrays have at most five dimensions and time before channel before space.
claims.reason: Bounds and conditional order match. No assumption that all five axes exist.

claims.claim: Transitional bioformats2raw.layout identifies series; conforming top-level metadata uses layout=3.
claims.reason: Requirement is conditional on conforming bioformats2raw layout, not every generic image group.

claims.claim: Plate metadata takes precedence and collections/plates cannot be mixed.
claims.reason: Precedence and negative constraint correctly retained.

claims.claim: OME group MAY have series string paths; order MUST match XML Images when XML is provided.
claims.reason: MAY and when-provided condition are preserved.

claims.claim: Without series and plate, consecutive numbered images from 0; each multiscales group is exactly one XML Image.
claims.reason: Numbering/order constrained to specified absence conditions.

claims.claim: Reader SHOULD disclose multiple images and not silently open first; MAY use series/show all/offer choice/ignore other root groups.
claims.reason: All reader recommendation/permission strengths preserved.

claims.claim: HCS uses three groups plate-row-well; well/plate implement specs; well images are fields; empty row/well groups SHOULD NOT exist.
claims.reason: Hierarchy and empty-group recommendation match.

claims.claim: Plate listing includes columns/rows/wells paths and 0-based consistent indices, field_count/version and optional acquisitions.
claims.reason: Columns/rows/wells/version are MUST, field_count SHOULD; acquisition list MAY. Names/maximumfieldcount are SHOULD, timestamps MAY. Report calls them optional without enumerating these strengths; no false mandatory field_count is explicitly stated.

claims.claim: Acquisition IDs are unique integer >=0; well images/path required and acquisition required for multiple acquisitions.
claims.reason: Core numeric and conditional obligations match. Acquisition must match plate entry; that finer validator is omitted.

claims.claim: Multiscales is a list; each entry MUST axes and datasets.
claims.reason: Dictionary/list requirement and fields match.

claims.claim: Axes length 2-5 equals dimensionality; 2-3 space axes, optional one time/channel/custom; order and conditional zyx recommendation.
claims.reason: Null custom-axis allowance is not explicitly repeated, but report allows custom and does not reject null.

claims.claim: Dataset path is group-relative; listed highest-resolution first; each level has coordinateTransformations.
claims.reason: Relative path, ordering and mandatory per-level geometry are preserved.

claims.claim: All datasets in an image group share dimensionality.
claims.reason: Rank/order equality is required within each multiscales dictionary matching its own axes. Multiple multiscales dictionaries each have their own axes; the cited text does not require all named multiscales in a group to share rank.

claims.claim: Name/downscaling type/metadata are SHOULD-level.
claims.reason: Key strengths and meaning correct.

claims.claim: If one multiscale use it; otherwise user can choose name with first fallback.
claims.reason: Useful selection guidance/permissive example; names are SHOULD, and user choice is a product decision. Not every missing name is malformed.

claims.claim: Named-selection pseudo-code is a normative example.
claims.reason: Conformance excludes examples from normative text. The example/pseudocode cannot supply a mandatory UI or fallback policy; source prose permits choice.

claims.claim: Metadata is attributes.ome in zarr.json; ome.version string 0.5 consistent within hierarchy and validates opening.
claims.reason: Namespace and consistency are explicit. Opening validation is a grounded plan inference.

claims.claim: Labels is nested container with declared label-image paths; intermediate folders allowed/no metadata; names arbitrary and registered.
claims.reason: Container/key/arbitrary names and intermediate negative constraint match. All label images SHOULD be listed, not guaranteed registered; report later preserves incomplete-list caveat at line70.

claims.claim: Any Zarr-v3 features may be used unless prohibited; reader cannot assume one codec or chunk layout.
claims.reason: Source permission supports compatibility validation and explicit unsupported errors. It does not require this small viewer to implement every codec/storage transformer.

claims.claim: Transitional metadata intended removal; implementations may be MUST/SHOULD encouraged to read.
claims.reason: Conditional general reading duty accurately distinguished from universal mandatory support.

claims.claim: Optional transitional omero requires channels matching c size and per-channel RGB hex color/window min,max,start,end.
claims.reason: Optional container and mandatory-if-present fields are separated correctly.

claims.claim: Example channels have active/coefficient/family/inverted/label and rdefs defaultT/defaultZ/model.
claims.reason: Report expressly identifies example fields; their meanings are illustrated, not universally required.

claims.claim: Axes name mandatory unique; recommended type/unit with custom types; axes rank and level dimension_names identity mandatory.
claims.reason: Checks match array-level requirement; optional dimensions/names are not fixed tczyx positions.

claims.claim: Transforms map coordinate spaces, sequential in order; scale/translation only in multiscales; identity general default; inline or path binary vectors.
claims.reason: General defaults/vector representations are correctly described. Dataset exactly-one scale is still mandatory; implicit identity is not a substitute.

claims.claim: Exactly one dataset scale gives physical pixel size/time; relative first-resolution factor only if unavailable, default1 when no downsampling.
claims.reason: Critical conditional distinction is preserved; no unconditional level-0 multiplication is claimed.

claims.claim: Optional exactly-one translation after scale, physical origin; vector lengths equal axes.
claims.reason: Ordering/cardinality/lengths preserved.

claims.claim: Multiscales transforms optionally apply to all levels after dataset transforms.
claims.reason: Order and optional scope preserved.

claims.claim: Axis order corresponds to array order: time if present, channel/custom if present, space; conditional zyx SHOULD.
claims.reason: No type-alone spatial-plane assertion appears. Detailed absent-vs-singleton navigation is nevertheless missing.

claims.claim: Label integer types include signed/unsigned8/16/32/64; multiscales required and level count equals original.
claims.reason: Exact integer domain and count rule match. End-to-end exact decoding/resampling is unaddressed.

claims.claim: Label is in source coordinate system, usually same dimensions/transforms; dimension same or1 if irrelevant.
claims.reason: Usually is correctly preserved for grid equality. Label dimension match-or-one is source recommendation, not universal exact-rank/grid guarantee.

claims.claim: image-label/colors/version are SHOULD-presence with mandatory array/string types and integer label-value keys.
claims.reason: Conditional presence/type requirements correctly preserved.

claims.claim: rgba optional four integer components0-255, fourth alpha; readers SHOULD use palette; example50%blue50%opacity.
claims.reason: Values and recommendation match; no universal palette styling MUST invented.

claims.claim: Properties optional, label-value-keyed arbitrary metadata, varying keys; source optional object with optional relative image path default../../.
claims.reason: Keying/source object/string relative-path requirements and default match. Actual resolution/registration validation not described.

claims.claim: Worked5D t/c/z/y/x units and level scale vectors [1,1,.5,.5,.5], [1,1,1,1,1], [1,1,2,2,2]; group [.1,1,1,1,1].
claims.reason: All example values/units are exact. Group time scale composes to0.1ms per t index.

claims.claim: Coordinate readout must reproduce that computation.
claims.reason: Correct when opening the specified example; these vectors are illustrative rather than universal defaults. No evaluated pixel/offset example is supplied.

claims.claim: Plan already covers localopen/list/panzoom/channels/timeplanes/optional overlays/details/pyramidlevel/backgroundcancel/failures/representative responsive acceptance.
claims.reason: Every cited behavior appears in the thin plan. This is an already-covered disposition rather than source novelty.

claims.reason: Sources ground layouts/SHOULD awareness; universal HCS rendering breadth is a proposed capability to review, not a format-mandated UI.

claims.claim: Use declared ordering and selected level transforms rather than level0 scale for all views.

claims.claim: Named multiscale choice is separate and not mentioned in thin plan.
